source.excludedPolicy: Git ignored files, metadata, runtime, dependency/build directories and credential filename patterns; no credential contents inspected.

reason: Explicit repository tests passed and copied source bytes are intact
limitations: Trusted repository tests execute as the host user; copied workspaces are not an adversarial OS sandbox.
Only direct test/*.test.js, test/*.test.mjs, genesis.test.mjs and reconstitution/*.test.js|mjs files are selected; Forge runner tests are excluded to avoid recursive copying.
TAP exit status, nonzero executed/passing counts and copied source integrity are required; logs retain bounded actual output.
Public-source snapshots have no Git history and use fixed public roots/extensions rather than claiming Git-ignore evaluation.
Runtime, source-copy cost and verification overhead are local wall-clock measurements, not a human productivity baseline.
No merge, deployment, provider call, authority expansion or publication is performed.
